Inspect devcontainer.json support without starting setup or a VM

Usage: coop devcontainer <COMMAND>

Commands:
  check   Parse devcontainer.json and print coop's translation report
  ignore  Persistently ignore discovered devcontainer.json for a project
  status  Show persistent devcontainer opt-outs
  clear   Clear a persistent devcontainer opt-out for a project
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
